blocks.text: Aaj ke daur mein pani bachana (conservation) bohat zaroori hai, kyun ke duniya ki aabadi ka bara hissa pani ki kami ka saamna kar raha hai. Yeh tareeqe pani bachane mein madad dete hain:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab “a large pollution fraction of the world” likhti hai; yahan “pollution” ki jagah “population” (aabadi) hona chahiye: duniya ki aabadi ka bara hissa pani ki kami ka saamna karta hai.

items: Kheti mein pani bachane wali technology, jaise drip irrigation (qatra qatra pani) aur sprinkler irrigation (phuar), pani ka zaya hona bohat kam karti hai aur fasal ki paidawar aur kaarkardagi (efficiency) barhati hai.

Greywater, yani gharon mein kapre dhone, bartan dhone aur nahane ka pani, ko dobara istemal (reuse) aur recycle karna: baghbani (landscaping), toilet flush aur industry mein thanda karne (cooling) ke liye. Is se taaza pani bachta hai aur sewage plants par bojh kam hota hai.
Shehron aur dehaat dono mein barish ka pani jama karne ke nizam (rainwater harvesting) lagana, pani pakarne aur jama karne ka der-pa (sustainable) tareeqa hai.
Pani ki supply ke pipes aur nizam (infrastructure) ki ba-qaida marammat aur dekh-bhaal se leak aur pani ka zaya hona kam hota hai.

Chhote dam aur recharge wells (zameen mein pani wapas bhejne wale kuen) banana barish ka pani jama karta aur zameen ke neeche ke pani ki sateh dobara bharta hai, taake khushk mausam mein bhi pani mile.
Logon ki shirakat aur aagahi (awareness): pani bachane ki aadaton par awami taleemi muhimmein, aur maqami logon ko pani ke zakhiron ki hifazat mein shamil karna.

blocks.prompt: Pani bachane ke chaar tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi chaar: drip ya sprinkler irrigation; greywater ka dobara istemal; rainwater harvesting; leak ki marammat; chhote dam aur recharge wells; awami aagahi muhimmein.

items: Drip aur sprinkler irrigation; greywater ka dobara istemal; rainwater harvesting; leak ki marammat; chhote dam aur recharge wells; aagahi.
